'''Ben Matthews''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[2000 Dagobah Regionals]] on 29 July 2000 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Ops flip]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|XWing HB]], according to Charlie Herren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1056">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-dagobah-regional-29-june-2000d1056/ dagobah-regional-29-june-2000], DeckTech (Charlie "CommieBoy" Herren, 30 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-dagobah-regional-29-june-2000d1056/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
